'''Hesker''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[General/Legends|general]] of the [[Imperial Guard]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
[[General/Legends|General]] Hesker was regarded as a brilliant field tactician, an accomplished pilot and virtually unstoppable in battle. He first saw military action as a young man during the [[Sacking of Coruscant]]; assigned to the first wave of shuttles to land on the surface, his squad was intended for a diversionary role to draw initial [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] fire. But Hesker refused to be used as mere [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fodder. Instead, he led his team in a furious assault that broke the Republic lines and transformed the battle into an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] rout.<ref name="TORC">{{TORcite|type=codex|General Hesker}}</ref>

[[File:General_Hesker.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Hesker during the [[Battle of Corellia]]]]
He quickly gained recognition inside both the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] and the [[Imperial Guard]], and his deeds since firmly established his reputation as one of the Empire's greatest military heroes. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Hesker became the head of the Imperial Guard stationed on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Battle of Corellia]]<ref name="TORC" /> and aided the Imperial spacers during the raid on the Green Jedi Enclave.<ref name="The Battle Of Corellia">{{TORcite|type=faction|[[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Empire]]|The Battle Of Corellia|[[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]}}</ref>

He eventually was present on [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] when [[Darth Malgus]] declared himself Emperor of the [[New Empire]].<ref name="Empire Betrayed">{{TORcite|type=faction|Empire|An Empire Betrayed|Ilum}}</ref> Chosen as the Imperial strike team's pilot during the [[Battle of Ilum]], he directed them and helped provide air support until he was shot down by [[Darth Serevin]], ejecting at the last minute as his ship crashed into a ravine.<ref name="Battle of Ilum">{{TORcite|type=flashpoint|The Battle of Ilum}}</ref> After Serevin's death, the strike team stole his vessel, which Hesker used to pilot them to Malgus' space station. As the strike team fought their way to Malgus, he engaged in dogfights with the stealth armada. Following Malgus's defeat, he rescued the team from the space station, now on the verge of self-destruct.<ref name="False Emperor">{{TORcite|type=flashpoint|The False Emperor}}</ref> He later attended the debriefing along with the strike team and other key Imperial leaders.<ref name="Empire Betrayed" />
